title: Guards against a missing file in the postinst, causing it to fail.
description:
Guards against a missing file in the postinst, causing it to fail.

PPA: https://launchpad.net/~graysonwolf/+archive/ubuntu/postfix-resolute-0a80c35f
DEP8: passed locally
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index f752b6f..682c9c7 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,11 @@
+postfix (3.10.6-4ubuntu2.2) resolute; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/postfix.postinst: guard against missing /etc/postfix/main.cf (LP: #2165958)
+  * d/p/linux-7-support.patch: support building on hosts running
+    Linux 7.x kernels (LP: #2167720)
+
+ -- Grayson Wolf <grayson.wolf@canonical.com>  Wed, 16 Sep 2026 15:34:36 -0400
+
 postfix (3.10.6-4ubuntu2.1) resolute-security; urgency=medium
 
   * SECURITY UPDATE: crash via an enhanced status code that lacks text after the
diff --git a/debian/patches/linux-7-support.patch b/debian/patches/linux-7-support.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c3f4378
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/linux-7-support.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+Subject: support building on hosts running Linux 7.x kernels
+From: Wietse Z Venema <wietse@porcupine.org>
+Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 00:00:00 -0500
+Origin: upstream, https://postfix.mirrors.ovh.net/postfix-release/experimental/postfix-3.12-20260227.tar.gz
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/postfix/+bug/2167720
+--- a/makedefs
++++ b/makedefs
+@@ -639,7 +639,7 @@
+ 		: ${SHLIB_ENV="LD_LIBRARY_PATH=`pwd`/lib"}
+ 		: ${PLUGIN_LD="${CC-gcc} -shared"}
+ 		;;
+-    Linux.[3456].*)
++    Linux.[34567].*)
+ 		SYSTYPE=LINUX$RELEASE_MAJOR
+ 		case "$CCARGS" in
+ 		 *-DNO_DB*) ;;
+--- a/src/util/sys_defs.h
++++ b/src/util/sys_defs.h
+@@ -763,7 +763,7 @@
+   * LINUX.
+   */
+ #if defined(LINUX2) || defined(LINUX3) || defined(LINUX4) || defined(LINUX5) \
+-	|| defined(LINUX6)
++	|| defined(LINUX6) || defined(LINUX7)
+ #define SUPPORTED
+ #define UINT32_TYPE	unsigned int
+ #define UINT16_TYPE	unsigned short
diff --git a/debian/patches/series b/debian/patches/series
index b9e3ee8..cf30fba 100644
--- a/debian/patches/series
+++ b/debian/patches/series
@@ -12,3 +12,4 @@ debian-systemd-start.patch
 debian-postfix-chroot-cmd.patch
 hurd.patch
 CVE-2026-43964.patch
+linux-7-support.patch
diff --git a/debian/postfix.postinst b/debian/postfix.postinst
index 78802f9..a4f7ae2 100644
--- a/debian/postfix.postinst
+++ b/debian/postfix.postinst
@@ -91,7 +91,7 @@ then
     # Since 3.9.0-3 we switched to upstream default which is empty,
     # which means to use built-in Cyrus SASL library defaults.
     # Debian policy says it should be /etc/postfix/sasl
-    if [ ! "$(postconf -hx cyrus_sasl_config_path)" ]; then
+    if [ -f /etc/postfix/main.cf ] && [ ! "$(postconf -hx cyrus_sasl_config_path)" ]; then
 	postconf -e cyrus_sasl_config_path=/etc/postfix/sasl
     fi
 fi
@@ -106,7 +106,7 @@ then
 
 fi
 
-if dpkg --compare-versions "$OLDVERSION" lt-nl 3.9.1-8~
+if [ -f /etc/postfix/main.cf ] && dpkg --compare-versions "$OLDVERSION" lt-nl 3.9.1-8~
 then
     if dir=$(postconf -hx html_directory) && [ no = "$dir" ]; then
 	postconf -e html_directory=/usr/share/doc/postfix/html
@@ -383,7 +383,7 @@ After modifying main.cf, be sure to run 'systemctl reload postfix'.
 EOF
 
 if dpkg --compare-versions "$OLDVERSION" lt-nl 3.9.1-7~ &&
-   dirs=$(postconf -hx multi_instance_directories) &&
+   dirs=$(postconf -hx multi_instance_directories 2>/dev/null) &&
    [ -d /run/systemd/system ]
 then # check for postfix@- multi-instances setup
     instances= outofconf=
